title: GET /api/v1/progress
description: P18. The rider's XP and level, earned by Discover finds and by completed GTBike V routes (the adapter listens to Course.OnCourseCompleted), plus the routes completed with their best time. Kept on the PC in %LOCALAPPDATA%\GTBikeVCompanion\v1\rider-progress.json. Same shape as the Discover add-on's progress.
